## Digester (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 N Medium magical beast  
 **Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +10  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 18, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural)  
 **hp** 104 (8d10+24)  
 **Fort** +9, **Ref** +10, **Will** +3  
 **Immune** acid  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 60 ft.  
 **Melee** claw +11 (1d8+4)  
 **Special Attacks** acid spray  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 17, **Dex** 15, **Con** 17, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +11; **CMD** 24  
 **Feats** Alertness, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +6 (+10 jumping)*, Perception +10, Sense Motive +3, Stealth* +13; **Racial Modifiers** +4 to Acrobatics when jumping, +4 to Stealth

 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Acid Spray (Ex)** A digester can spray acid in a 20-foot cone, dealing 4d8 points of damage to everything in that area. The digester can also choose to deliver a concentrated stream of acid that deals 8d8 points of damage against a single target within 5 feet. A DC 17 Reflex save halves the damage for both the cone and the stream. A digester may only use this ability once every 1d4 rounds. The save DC is Constitution-based.  
 
 

**Ecology**

 
**Environment** warm forests or temperate plains  
 **Organization** solitary, pack (3-6), or herd (7-20)  
 **Treasure** none
